summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the approval of a final mandatory dividend of US$37,995,268.60 (US$0.0000661689498 per share) at its ordinary shareholders' meeting. The dividend, together with an interim dividend paid in December 2025, represents 30% of distributable net income for fiscal year 2025. Payment will begin May 14, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 8, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and does not constitute a special situation.
